subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Cardinal Directions as Sacred
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Cardinal Directions as Sacred.

hook.text: North, south, east, west—four directions structure space the way three realms structure height. Horizontal order.

buildup.text: Chinese cosmology assigns directions colors: east is green, south is red, west is white, north is black.

discovery.text: In Navajo tradition, four sacred mountains mark the boundaries of the homeland. Geography becomes theology.

twist.text: Medieval maps placed east on top—that's why we say 'orientation.' The sacred direction was toward Jerusalem.

climax.text: The four directions aren't just geography—they're a moral and spiritual framework imposed on empty space.

punchline.text: Four directions. Four meanings. One world.

quiz.question: Why were medieval European maps oriented with east at the top?
options: East pointed toward Jerusalem, the sacred direction
